notes: Cross-verse split with EXO.40.8 on the compound adverbial *round about*. EXO.40.8 gives both words to סָבִיב; this verse gave *round* to סָבִיב and *about* to the following לַ. The corpus reads סָבִיב as *round about* headed on *round* in 144 units and as a bare *round* in only two — 1KI.18.35, which is the same split, is flagged medium and names the fused reading as equally defensible, and EZK.37.2, where the ASV writes *round* and *about* for two separate סָבִיב tokens. In the exact environment of this verse (סָבִיב followed by a determined preposition) precedent gives the whole compound to the adverb in four units against that one hedged split, and לְ → *about* exists in only three corpus units, one of which is again 1KI.18.35. The compound is one rendering of which no morpheme owns a part (rules 24, 30), so it goes whole to סָבִיב and the לַ is left with nothing the ASV has written for its own relation (rule 40) — the same disposition the verse already gave the coordinated second לַ.
